titleEn: A Spoonful of Porridge, a Spoonful of Story!

pages.text: The crane coughed and coughed. "I seem to have caught a cold..." He lay weakly beneath his quilt.
Kota paced outside his room. They wanted to go in, but didn't know what to do. They fiddled with their toes.
"I want him to get better..." Kota tugged Dad's robe. "But I can't make medicine or cook porridge."
Dad lifted a little tray of porridge. "There's something you can make—story medicine. Shall we go together?" "A story... is medicine?"
Dad offered a spoonful of porridge, and Kota offered a spoonful of story. "I saw a dragonfly in the yard today!" The crane took a sip and smiled a little.
A spoonful of porridge, a spoonful of story. The first steam, hopping backward, the steamed bun... Soon the bowl was half empty.
"Ha! Those tasty stories helped all that porridge go down." A little strength returned to his voice. Kota's tail lifted.
The crane stretched his long neck out of the quilt. "Another dose of story medicine tomorrow, please." "Yes! I'll make the funniest one!" Kota patted their chest.
The next day, Kota sat close beside his quilt and counted. "One, sit beside you! Two, a spoonful of porridge! Three, a spoonful of story!" Story medicine was Kota's specialty.
That evening, Dad rested his cheek against his little storyteller's. "Being there is the warmest medicine." "More porridge and stories tomorrow!" Kota was already choosing the next story.
